info.name: Protec UAT2 - Issuance, Endorsement, Query and Commission (one policy per product)
info.description: Checks issuance, endorsement, query and commission APIs for PCAR, P2W, PCV and GCV on protecuat2. Set username and password in the environment. Run folders in order: 0 Token, 1 Issuance, 2 Endorsements, 3 Queries, 4 Commission. Issuance creates one policy per product on float.

exec: const p=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('endoPolicy_PCAR'));let n=0;p.PolicyLobList[0].PolicyRiskList[0].PolicyCoverageList.forEach(cv=>(cv.PolicyBenefitList||[]).forEach(b=>{if(['NPPA','ADPAPAS'].includes(b.ProductElementCode)){b.PersonName='Meera Sharma';b.RelationWithInsured='S';n++;}}));if(!n){throw new Error('no nominee benefit on policy');}const body={PolicyNo:pm.collectionVariables.get('policyNo_PCAR'),EndoType:'1',EndoSubType:'11',EndorsementPaymentInfoList:[{PayModeCode:100}],NewPolicy:p};pm.request.body.update({mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify(body)});
